mapper.insert: INSERT INTO template ( title, canvas_data, created_at, updated_at, thumbnailpath ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{canvasData}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{thumbnailpath} )
INSERT INTO template_active (tmpno, UpdDate, Updpn, ClCd) VALUES ( #{tmpno}, getdate(), 'systemadmin', #{clcd} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, canvas_data AS canvasData, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, thumbnailpath FROM template ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, title, canvas_data AS canvasData, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, thumbnailpath FROM template WHERE id = #{id}
